newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timbers to buy 1 mln CT Royalty units.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timbers to buy 1 mln CT Royalty units.

text.p: Cross Timbers Oil Co said Wednesday its board has authorized the purchase of up to one million additional units of beneficial interest in Cross Timbers Royalty Trust.
The new purchases will depend on availability, oil and gas prices and general market conditions, and follow completion of a previously announced program to buy one million units, the company said.
Bob Simpson, chairman and chief executive, said the acquisition of the units allows the company to add high quality, royalty reserves for an attractive price.

Cross Timbers Royalty, created in 1991, holds interests carved from gas-producing royalties in the San Juan Basin and working interests in oil-producing properties in Texas and Oklahoma. The company has six million units outstanding.
Cross Timbers Oil acquires and develops oil and gas properties in Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas, New Mexico and Wyoming.
